description: Places an unpaid order for the customer from the same arguments as get_quote plus their name, email and E.164 phone. The response carries signed links: pay_url is our payment page (card, PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay) to give the customer, status_url shows the order and collects any missing documents. Links last 48 hours. A customer whose email already has an account receives the links by email instead, and the response says so: tell them to check their inbox. Documents can be sent first with send_document, or uploaded by the customer at the status_url after paying when you create the order from a page count. Pass idempotency_key so a retry never places a second order.

certification.description: Omit for standard; the response lists every option the pair offers with its total.

country_of_use.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the translation is for, e.g. ES for a sworn translation for Spain.

currency.description: The currency to quote in; each is its own price sheet. Defaults to GBP.

customer_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the customer's country. Outside GB no VAT is charged.

file_tokens.description: Tokens from send_document for the documents to translate.

idempotency_key.description: Your own unique key for this order attempt; a retry with the same key within a day returns the order already placed instead of a second one.

notes.description: Anything the translator should know: names to keep, the purpose, formatting wishes.

phone.description: The customer's phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +14155552671

quantity.description: Pages to translate (a page is up to 250 words). With file_tokens the documents are measured instead, and a quantity can only raise the measured count. A quote without either prices one page and says so in quantity_assumed; create_order needs a quantity or file_tokens.

source_language.description: Source language code from list_languages, e.g. en-gb

target_language.description: Target language code from list_languages, e.g. es

name: create_order
title: Create an unpaid order
